title: audio.transcript body v1
description: ASR output, partial and final. Publisher: jv-ears (whisper.cpp streaming, CPU). Partials with the same utterance_id supersede each other; exactly one final per utterance_id. Envelope conf = ASR confidence for the text.

kind.description: Partials are provisional and may be rewritten; only finals are acted on.

utterance_id.description: UUID from audio.vad speech_start; ties partials to their final.

text.description: Transcript so far (partial) or complete utterance (final).

lang.description: Detected language, BCP-47 primary tag ('en', 'he'). Whisper may detect Hebrew; replies stay English (locked decision).

t0.description: Start of transcribed audio, seconds relative to utterance start.

t1.description: End of transcribed audio, seconds relative to utterance start.

words.description: Optional word-level timing (finals only, if the ASR provides it).
